newsitem.title: USA: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. soybean weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA soybean export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 447,000 MT slid 37 percent from the previous week, but equaled the 4-week average. Major increases for the Netherlands (197,800 MT, includes 103,200 new sales and 95,600 destination changes), Japan (123,500 MT), Taiwan (76,500 MT, includes 24,500 new sales and 52,000 destination changes), and Indonesia (68,600 MT) were partially offset by reductions for unknown destinations (127,200 MT) and South Korea (37,300 MT).

Exports of 962,100 MT were 61 percent above the previous week and 43 percent above the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Netherlands (318,900 MT), Taiwan (126,900 MT), Japan (101,700 MT), Spain (90,300 MT), Mexico (70,400 MT), and China (52,600 MT).
